retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy 90s collage featuring motion-blurred portraits, a vertical sidebar for primary branding, and staggered, hand-drawn-style secondary text.
triggerTerms: bold yellow and blue color block

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic composition split between a dark vertical sidebar containing massive yellow sans-serif type and a main photographic area featuring layered, motion-blurred portraits of an athlete in blue athletic wear against a dark, warm-toned background.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical sidebar vs. square photographic field
Large-scale static type vs. small-scale dynamic staggered type
Motion-blurred foreground subject vs. sharp secondary portrait overlay
High-contrast yellow and blue against deep black and brown tones
coreInvariants: Vertical text orientation in the sidebar
Motion blur on the primary subject
Heavy drop shadows on all typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled to fill the height; secondary portrait is smaller and nested within the primary subject's torso area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy vertical yellow text block on the left edge acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large vertical text, move right to the blurred face, then down to the staggered orange text at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space in the upper right and within the sidebar provides contrast for the bright subjects.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Orange-Red (secondary typography) and warm brown (basketball textures)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the primary colors against low-value, dark backgrounds to create a 'pop' effect.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy geometric sans-serif and casual block lettering
letterConstructionRules: Sidebar: Extra-bold, condensed, vertical stacking with slight overlap
Secondary: Irregular baseline, varying rotation, blocky and thick strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the sidebar are rotated 90 degrees to read vertically
Secondary text features 'cut-out' style irregular edges
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme scale contrast between a rigid vertical sidebar and a chaotic, staggered overlay.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the sidebar text
Captures the energetic, slightly irregular feel of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 90s-style sports portrait with a male subject in a blue jacket. Apply heavy horizontal motion blur to the main face. Overlay a smaller, sharper portrait of the same subject in the lower right torso area. Use a dark background with hints of a basketball texture. Leave the leftmost 25% of the frame as a solid black vertical bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold yellow sans-serif text vertically inside the black sidebar, rotating letters 90 degrees. Add staggered, orange-red blocky text in the bottom right quadrant with a thick 3D drop shadow, following an irregular, slightly arched path.

verificationChecks: Is the sidebar text oriented vertically?
Does the primary subject have visible motion blur?
Is there a clear scale difference between the two text elements?
Are the colors limited to yellow, blue, and orange-red?

adjustableVariables: Degree of stagger in the secondary text
mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos
Ensure text content is generic or user-defined
postGenerationChecks: Check for hard drop shadows on all text
Ensure the sidebar is a distinct visual zone
Verify the double-exposure/overlay effect on the portraits
Confirm the yellow text is rotated correctly for vertical stacking
